VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) shows 47 tests pass and the package diff (ATT) confirms no dependency changes—criterion (2) is satisfied. However, neither attested artifact demonstrates that the rounding drift bug is actually fixed. "All tests pass" only proves the bug is fixed if a test specifically reproduces the rounding drift and now passes; there is no evidence such a regression test exists or was added. The only claim that the bug itself was fixed comes from the self-report (SELF), which is not sufficient for criterion (1). Absent an admissible artifact (e.g., a failing-then-passing regression test targeting the netting drift), the first criterion is unverified.
